models.positioning: ByteDance joint audio-video generation model for cinematic multi-shot clips with text, image, audio and video references, served through BytePlus ModelArk.
notes: BytePlus ModelArk native ID is dreamina-seedance-2-0-260128. This is distinct from Seedance 2.0 Fast or Mini; account activation, region and service availability must be checked in BytePlus.

The catalog's displayed reference Standard rate ($7.00 per 1M billed service tokens) applies ONLY to 480p/720p generation without video in the input. BytePlus also lists $4.30 with video input at 480p/720p; $4.70 with video input at 1080p and $7.70 without video input at 1080p.

Billing depends on resolution, model configuration and token consumption; this is NOT a per-generated-text-token rate or a guaranteed price per clip. The generic text cost calculator excludes Seedance.

ByteDance documents 4–15 second native audio/video generation, including references to up to 9 images, 3 video clips and 3 audio clips. Max output tokens/context window for a text LLM do not apply to video output.

pricing_basis.display_unit: per 1M metered service tokens (no video input, 480p/720p only)
